verses.text: A revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His slaves the things that must take place soon. He made it known by sending through His angel to His slave John,
verses.display_text: A revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His slaves the things that must take place soon. He made it known by sending through His angel to His slave John,

verses.text: who testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, all that he saw.

verses.text: John, to the seven Churches in Asia: grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before His throne,

verses.text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the One who loveth us and freed us from our sins in His blood—

verses.text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” saith the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.
verses.display_text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” saith the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.

verses.display_text: I, John, your brother and fellow partner in the affliction and kingdom and endurance in Jesus, came to be on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

verses.display_text: and in the midst of the lampstands One like a son of man, clothed in a robe reaching to the feet and girded around the chest with a golden belt.

verses.text: “To the angel of the Church in Ephesus write: These things saith the One who holdeth the seven stars in His right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
verses.display_text: “To the angel of the Church in Ephesus write: These things saith the One who holdeth the seven stars in His right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:

verses.text: ‘I know thy works, and the labour and thine endurance, and that thou canst not bear evil people; and thou didst test those who call themselves apostles and are not, and didst find them false.
verses.display_text: ‘I know thy works, and the labour and thine endurance, and that thou canst not bear evil people; and thou didst test those who call themselves apostles and are not, and didst find them false.

verses.text: And thou hast endurance and didst bear up for My name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.
verses.display_text: And thou hast endurance and didst bear up for My name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.

verses.text: But I have this against thee: thou didst abandon thy first love.
verses.display_text: But I have this against thee: thou didst abandon thy first love.

verses.text: Therefore remember from whence thou hast fallen, and repent and do the first works. Otherwise I am coming to thee and will move thy lampstand from its place, unless thou repent.
verses.display_text: Therefore remember from whence thou hast fallen, and repent and do the first works. Otherwise I am coming to thee and will move thy lampstand from its place, unless thou repent.

verses.text: But this thou hast: thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.display_text: But this thou hast: thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

verses.text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’
verses.display_text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’

verses.text: And to the angel of the Church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who became dead and lived:
verses.display_text: And to the angel of the Church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who became dead and lived:

verses.text: ‘I know thine affliction and poverty—but thou art rich—and the slander from those who say that they themselves are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.display_text: ‘I know thine affliction and poverty—but thou art rich—and the slander from those who say that they themselves are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

verses.text: Fear none of the things thou art about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that ye may be tested, and ye shall have affliction for ten days. Become faithful until death, and I will give thee the crown of life.
verses.display_text: Fear none of the things thou art about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that ye may be tested, and ye shall have affliction for ten days. Become faithful until death, and I will give thee the crown of life.

verses.text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. The one who conquereth shall certainly not be harmed by the second death.’
verses.display_text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. The one who conquereth shall certainly not be harmed by the second death.’

verses.text: And to the angel of the Church in Pergamum write: These things saith the One who hath the sharp two-edged sword:
verses.display_text: And to the angel of the Church in Pergamum write: These things saith the One who hath the sharp two-edged sword:

verses.text: ‘I know where thou dwellest, where Satan’s throne is, and thou holdest fast My name and didst not deny My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.display_text: ‘I know where thou dwellest, where Satan’s throne is, and thou holdest fast My name and didst not deny My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.

verses.text: But I have a few things against thee: thou hast there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
verses.display_text: But I have a few things against thee: thou hast there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.

verses.text: So thou also hast those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in the same way.
verses.display_text: So thou also hast those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in the same way.

verses.text: Therefore repent. Otherwise I am coming to thee quickly and will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
verses.display_text: Therefore repent. Otherwise I am coming to thee quickly and will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

verses.text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth except the one who receiveth it.’
verses.display_text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches. To the one who conquereth I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth except the one who receiveth it.’

verses.text: And to the angel of the Church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath His eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like burnished bronze:
verses.display_text: And to the angel of the Church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath His eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like burnished bronze:

verses.text: ‘I know thy works and love and faith and service and thine endurance, and thy last works are more than the first.
verses.display_text: ‘I know thy works and love and faith and service and thine endurance, and thy last works are more than the first.

verses.text: But I have this against thee: thou allowest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess, and she teacheth and deceiveth My slaves to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.display_text: But I have this against thee: thou allowest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess, and she teacheth and deceiveth My slaves to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.

verses.text: And I gave her time to repent, and she doth not wish to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.display_text: And I gave her time to repent, and she doth not wish to repent of her sexual immorality.

verses.text: Behold, I am throwing her into a bed, and those committing adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works.
verses.display_text: Behold, I am throwing her into a bed, and those committing adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works.

verses.text: And I will kill her children with death, and all the Churches will know that I am the One who searcheth kidneys and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
verses.display_text: And I will kill her children with death, and all the Churches will know that I am the One who searcheth kidneys and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.

verses.text: But to you, the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they say, I say: I place no other burden upon you.
verses.display_text: But to you, the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they say, I say: I place no other burden upon you.

verses.text: Only hold fast what ye have until I come.
verses.display_text: Only hold fast what ye have until I come.

verses.text: And to the one who conquereth and keepeth My works until the end, I will give authority over the nations,
verses.display_text: And to the one who conquereth and keepeth My works until the end, I will give authority over the nations,

verses.text: and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as vessels of pottery are shattered,
verses.display_text: and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as vessels of pottery are shattered,

verses.text: as I also have received from My Father; and I will give him the morning star.
verses.display_text: as I also have received from My Father; and I will give him the morning star.

verses.text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’
verses.display_text: Let the one who hath an ear hear what the Spirit saith to the Churches.’

verses.text: And to the angel of the Church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation:

verses.text: ‘I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot. Would that thou wert cold or hot.

verses.display_text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and upon them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.text: And the one speaking with me had a golden measuring reed, to measure the city and its gates and its wall.
verses.display_text: And the one speaking with me had a golden measuring reed, to measure the city and its gates and its wall.

verses.text: And the city lieth foursquare, and its length is as great as its width. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and width and height are equal.
verses.display_text: And the city lieth foursquare, and its length is as great as its width. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and width and height are equal.

verses.text: And he measured its wall at a hundred forty-four cubits, a human measure, which is an angel’s.
verses.display_text: And he measured its wall at a hundred forty-four cubits, a human measure, which is an angel’s.

verses.text: And the construction of its wall was jasper, and the city pure gold like pure glass.
verses.display_text: And the construction of its wall was jasper, and the city pure gold like pure glass.

verses.text: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
verses.display_text: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

verses.text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
verses.display_text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.

verses.text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was from one pearl. And the broad street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
verses.display_text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was from one pearl. And the broad street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

verses.text: And I saw no temple therein, for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.
verses.display_text: And I saw no temple therein, for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.

verses.text: And the city hath no need of the sun or the moon to shine upon it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.display_text: And the city hath no need of the sun or the moon to shine upon it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

verses.text: And the nations will walk through its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
verses.display_text: And the nations will walk through its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.

verses.text: And its gates will certainly not be shut by day, for there will be no night there,
verses.display_text: And its gates will certainly not be shut by day, for there will be no night there,

verses.text: and they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it.
verses.display_text: and they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it.

verses.text: And nothing common, and no one practicing abomination and falsehood, will ever enter it, but only those written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.display_text: And nothing common, and no one practicing abomination and falsehood, will ever enter it, but only those written in the Lamb’s book of life.

verses.text: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, coming out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
verses.display_text: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, coming out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

verses.text: in the middle of its broad street. And on this side and that side of the river was a tree of life bearing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
verses.display_text: in the middle of its broad street. And on this side and that side of the river was a tree of life bearing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

verses.text: And no accursed thing will be any more. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His slaves will serve Him,
verses.display_text: And no accursed thing will be any more. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His slaves will serve Him,

verses.text: and they will see His face, and His name will be upon their foreheads.
verses.display_text: and they will see His face, and His name will be upon their foreheads.

verses.text: And night will be no more, and they have no need of lamplight and sunlight, because the Lord God will shine upon them, and they will reign for the ages of the ages.
verses.display_text: And night will be no more, and they have no need of lamplight and sunlight, because the Lord God will shine upon them, and they will reign for the ages of the ages.

verses.text: And he said unto me, “These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His slaves the things that must take place soon.”
verses.display_text: And he said unto me, “These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His slaves the things that must take place soon.”

verses.text: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keepeth the words of the prophecy of this scroll.”
verses.display_text: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keepeth the words of the prophecy of this scroll.”

verses.text: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
verses.display_text: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.

verses.text: And he saith unto me, “See that thou do it not! I am thy fellow slave and of thy brothers the prophets and of those keeping the words of this scroll. Worship God.”
verses.display_text: And he saith unto me, “See that thou do it not! I am thy fellow slave and of thy brothers the prophets and of those keeping the words of this scroll. Worship God.”

verses.text: And he saith unto me, “Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this scroll, for the time is near.
verses.display_text: And he saith unto me, “Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this scroll, for the time is near.

verses.text: Let the one doing wrong do wrong still, and let the filthy one be filthy still, and let the righteous one do righteousness still, and let the holy one be sanctified still.”
verses.display_text: Let the one doing wrong do wrong still, and let the filthy one be filthy still, and let the righteous one do righteousness still, and let the holy one be sanctified still.”

verses.text: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to repay each according to what his work is.
verses.display_text: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to repay each according to what his work is.

verses.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”
verses.display_text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”

verses.text: Blessed are they who wash their robes, that they may have right to the tree of life and may enter through the gates into the city.
verses.display_text: Blessed are they who wash their robes, that they may have right to the tree of life and may enter through the gates into the city.

verses.text: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone loving and practicing falsehood.
verses.display_text: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone loving and practicing falsehood.

verses.text: “I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify these things to you for the Churches. I am the Root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.”
verses.display_text: “I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify these things to you for the Churches. I am the Root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.”

verses.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who heareth say, “Come.” And let the one who thirsteth come; let the one who wisheth take water of life freely.
verses.display_text: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who heareth say, “Come.” And let the one who thirsteth come; let the one who wisheth take water of life freely.

verses.text: I testify to everyone who heareth the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone addeth to them, God will add to him the plagues written in this scroll.
verses.display_text: I testify to everyone who heareth the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone addeth to them, God will add to him the plagues written in this scroll.

verses.text: And if anyone taketh away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away his share from the tree of life and from the holy city, the things written in this scroll.
verses.display_text: And if anyone taketh away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away his share from the tree of life and from the holy city, the things written in this scroll.

verses.text: The One testifying these things saith, “Yea, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
verses.display_text: The One testifying these things saith, “Yea, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
